method: from-scratch pure-Python baseline-JPEG Huffman/DCT decoder; extract quantized-DCT AC coefficients in scan order; jsteg model = LSB of every nonzero AC coeff; test frac_ones, chi2 vs uniform, packed-LSB entropy+printable, readable-prefix (PGP/gzip/zip)
note: full-page decodes (no MCU cap). Capped runs hide signal because LP2 pages are black runes on a large flat-white Ghostscript margin -> leading MCUs have all-zero AC coeffs.

control_positive.interpretation: even the real carrier shows HIGH parity bias, not flattening -> OutGuess preserves the coefficient histogram by design; sequential-LSB read cannot recover an OutGuess payload, but a jsteg/naive embed WOULD flatten chi2 -> our test is a valid jsteg-class detector

verdict: NULL. All LP2 pages show the natural DCT-LSB parity bias of a clean JPEG (frac1 0.57-0.60, high chi2 = NOT flattened). The 3 OutGuess-false-positive pages (0/4/26) are statistically indistinguishable from an ordinary page (p30). No jsteg-class DCT-LSB payload, no readable ASCII/PGP/gzip/zip prefix on any page. CLOSES the DCT-domain gap the prior STEGO-VERDICT left open ('not testable here').
